family: electrically cooled HPGe portable radionuclide identifier
description: Portable HPGe radionuclide identifier with a 2.4 x 1.2 inch HPGe detector (20-3000 keV) cooled by an internal refrigeration unit, G-M tube, optional He-3 neutron detector (N20), tablet control over WiFi/Ethernet, two hot-swappable Li-ion packs (~4 h each with a cold detector), operating -4 to 122 F (-20 to +50 C), 34.1 lb.

documents.title: Handheld Radionuclide Identification Devices (RIDs) Market Survey Report (DHS S&T SAVER / NUSTL, September 2015), section 3.3 Canberra Falcon 5000 and Table 3-1
